newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NEI Africa shares rally on good order news.
newsitem.headline: NEI Africa shares rally on good order news.

text.p: Shares in engineering firm NEI Africa Holdings jumped on Thursday following the company's announcement that its export orders had soared in the first quarter of 1997, dealers said.
"Obviously this is something positive for the share. The market has taken this as positive news," one dealer said.
The NEI Africa stock added 45 cents to reach 875 cents after the announcement.
The company's chief executive John Kempster said the firm's order intake for the first quarter was more than 100 million rand and was already matching last year's entire export order book.
He attributed the success largely to greater synergy and co-operation with shareholder Rolls Royce Plc's worldwide sales and marketing network.
Strong performers in the group included NEI Transformers, Reyrolle Switchgear and John Thompson Africa, a company statement said.
